<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we talk about?

Relaxing in the sun is also incorporated
into Neo-Aikido's training regimen!

When sunbathing, the chakra within
your body...

Um... It sorta... you know...
it...gets all kinds of good!

Impossible! Holding hands and twirling
around with a degenerate male...

That's just torture for me!
It would be like hell on Earth!

If you wanna dance, then dance alone!
You should pass out while you're at it!

Of course, degenerates never make
any sense.

We head outside and now we're going back
inside? What are you thinking?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Tenko looks deep in thought...
